summary: Project now includes building a full working admin dashboard/panel for managing app data.
architectural_notes: Add an admin dashboard route/page (e.g., /admin) protected by admin authentication/authorization for managing app content.

existing_features.title: Make the Admin Dashboard discoverable and accessible: ensure there is a visible navigation entry to the admin dashboard for administrators and that the admin dashboard is reachable at the /admin route (with sub-routes /admin/categories, /admin/breeds, /admin/videos).
Deliver a complete Admin Dashboard experience with working CRUD for pet categories, breeds, and admin-managed video links, including image upload support, using the existing admin pages and hooks.

Apply a cohesive, distinct visual theme for the admin dashboard pages (layout, typography, spacing, and component styling) that is consistent across /admin, /admin/categories, /admin/breeds, and /admin/videos.

new_feature_requests.summary: Build a full working admin dashboard/panel (visible page/route) with admin login and CRUD management for breeds, categories, videos, and other pet data.

Implement a reliable admin authorization flow so at least one administrator can successfully pass the frontend admin check (actor.isCallerAdmin) after deployment and can use the admin dashboard end-to-end.
